# SeaBee Jack's Mobile Oil Change & More, LLC

> Veteran-owned, family-operated mobile mechanic and auto repair service based in Surprise, AZ. Mobile-only (no walk-in shop). Most oil changes done in about 15 minutes. Full synthetic oil only (no blends, no conventional). 200+ five-star Google reviews. Honest upfront pricing, 90-day / 4,000-mile labor warranty.

## Business facts

- **Legal name:** SeaBee Jack's Mobile Oil Change & More, LLC
- **Phone:** (623) 226-3940 (call or text)
- **Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM MST
- **Location:** Surprise, AZ 85374 (mobile service, no walk-in)
- **Service area:** Surprise, Sun City, Sun City West, Peoria, Glendale, El Mirage, Litchfield Park, Goodyear, Waddell, Wittmann, Buckeye (incl. Verrado), Avondale, Tempe, Phoenix & North Phoenix
- **Payment:** Cash or card; estimates by phone are free
- **Warranty:** 90 days or 4,000 miles on labor; manufacturer warranty on parts
- **Reviews:** 200+ five-star Google reviews (5.0 average); positions itself as the #1 rated oil change in Arizona
- **Oil offering:** Full synthetic only (no blends, no conventional)
- **Average oil-change time:** About 15 minutes, start to finish
- **Founder background:** Navy Seabee veteran

## Services

- [Mobile Oil Change](/services/mobile-oil-change.html) — full synthetic only, plus a quality filter; about 15 minutes; containment mats down, used oil and filter packed out and recycled
- [Brake Service](/services/brake-service.html) — pads, rotors, brake fluid service; on-site brake jobs in your driveway
- [Battery Test & Replacement](/services/battery-test-replace.html) — load testing, alternator and starter diagnosis, heat-rated batteries replaced on the spot
- [Filters & Tune-Up](/services/filters-tune-up.html) — engine air, cabin air, fuel, PCV filters; spark plugs and ignition components on most makes
- [Fluid Service](/services/fluid-service.html) — coolant, brake fluid, power steering, transmission, differential, using manufacturer-spec fluids
- [Mobile Auto Repair](/services/mobile-auto-repair.html) — starters, alternators, sensors, belts, hoses, general repair, OBD-II diagnostics
- [Fleet Service](/services/fleet-service.html) — scheduled on-site maintenance for small local fleets (landscape, contractor, delivery, mobile service vehicles); billed monthly or per vehicle
- [Multi-Point Inspection](/services/multi-point-inspection.html) — bumper-to-bumper check with written report; also pre-purchase inspections

## Common questions

- Do you really come to me? Yes, Jack brings the oil, filters, and tools to your driveway, your work parking lot, or wherever the vehicle sits.
- How long does a mobile oil change take? About 15 minutes for a full synthetic oil change, start to finish.
- What oil do you use? Full synthetic only, plus a quality filter. We do not offer synthetic blend or conventional oil.
- What areas do you cover? The entire Phoenix West Valley including Surprise, Sun City, Sun City West, Peoria, Glendale, El Mirage, Litchfield Park, Goodyear, Waddell, Wittmann, Buckeye, Avondale, plus Tempe and parts of Phoenix and North Phoenix.
- How does pricing work? Real upfront price before any work starts. Phone estimates are free.
- Do you take fleets? Yes, small local fleets, scheduled recurring service, billed per vehicle or monthly.
- What is the warranty? 90 days or 4,000 miles on labor; parts under manufacturer warranty.
- How many reviews do you have? 200+ five-star Google reviews from West Valley and Phoenix-area drivers.
